items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: I did some arranging for Powell -- the last name; he had a big band down there in the Famous Door. I did some arranging for him.

ctx.x: '38. Arranging for Basie and I was arranging... I wrote some arrangements for Red Norvo, and I did some arranging for Powell -- the last name; he had a big band down there in the Famous Door. I did some arranging for him.
